about.description: Single-stock perpetual market on Ondo Perps tracking Nebius Group N.V., cash-settled, 24/7, up to 20x leverage, margined in USDC. Users get linear price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Adapter snapshot 2026-08-19: mark $227.6300, open interest $666.58K, 24h volume $1.27M. Added 2026-08-19 to reconcile the registry with Ondo's stated 35 RWA markets; the adapter's 40 rows include 5 crypto perps (BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE, ONDO) that are out of scope.
